# StoryGen Pro


Turn Pega GenAI Blueprints into sprint-ready, execution-grade user stories in minutes - not manual backlog authoring.

By using or submitting listings via the Pega Marketplace, you agree to our[Terms of Use](https://community.pega.com/knowledgebase/articles/pega-marketplace-terms-use) .


### Overview


StoryGen Pro converts Pega GenAI Blueprints, BRDs, meeting transcripts, or plain-text requirements into structured, delivery-ready Agile user stories, directly inside Agile Studio. It automatically derives acceptance criteria and exception scenarios stage-by-stage, using the Blueprint as the single source of truth. Built for product owners, business analysts, scrum masters, and delivery teams, it supports both new Blueprint-driven journeys and existing Pega case types. Generated backlogs can be pushed with one click to JIRA, Azure DevOps, or Pega Agile Studio, or exported as a ready-to-share Excel sheet or FSD document. Ideal for discovery and requirements work, new case type build-outs, regulated/compliance-heavy processes, client sign-off, and multi-team sprint planning - StoryGen Pro helps blueprints become the backlog itself.


### Key Features


- Stage-by-stage backlog generation directly from a Pega GenAI Blueprint
- Single user story generation from a plain-text description
- Full backlog generation from a Business Requirements Document (BRD)
- Full backlog generation from a meeting transcript
- One-click push of the backlog to ADO, JIRA, or Pega Agile Studio
- Backlog or FSD export as a ready-to-share Excel file
- Auto-generated living product manuals from tested, completed stories
